import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.naive_bayes import MultinomialNB
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
import re
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")


def preprocess_text(text):
    """Clean and normalize text before vectorization"""
    text = str(text).lower()
    text = re.sub(r"[^\w\s]", " ", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\d+", "", text)
    return text.strip()


def compute_doc_stats(text):
    """Compute document-level statistical features"""
    # Count punctuation
    excl_count = len(re.findall(r"!", str(text)))
    quest_count = len(re.findall(r"\?", str(text)))
    comma_count = len(re.findall(r",", str(text)))

    # Split into words
    words = str(text).split()
    word_count = len(words)

    # Capitalization density (before lowercasing for this metric)
    original_text = str(text)
    upper_words = sum(1 for w in original_text.split() if w[0].isupper())

    features = {
        "punc_ratio": (excl_count + quest_count + comma_count) / max(1, word_count),
        "capital_ratio": upper_words / max(1, word_count),
        "total_punct": excl_count + quest_count + comma_count,
    }

    return features


def main():
    # Paths
    input_path = "./input"
    submission_path = "./submission"
    train_csv = os.path.join(input_path, "train.csv")
    test_csv = os.path.join(input_path, "test.csv")
    sample_submission_csv = os.path.join(input_path, "sample_submission.csv")

    # Create submission directory if not exists
    os.makedirs(submission_path, exist_ok=True)

    # Load Data
    print("Loading data...")
    df_train = pd.read_csv(train_csv)
    df_test = pd.read_csv(test_csv)
    df_sample = pd.read_csv(sample_submission_csv)

    # Prepare Target
    label_map = {"EAP": 0, "HPL": 1, "MWS": 2}
    reverse_label_map = {0: "EAP", 1: "HPL", 2: "MWS"}

    y_train = df_train["author"].map(label_map).values
    X_train_text = df_train["text"]
    ids_train = df_train["id"].values

    X_test_text = df_test["text"]
    ids_test = df_test["id"].values

    # Apply text preprocessing
    print("Preprocessing text...")
    X_train_processed = [preprocess_text(text) for text in X_train_text]
    X_test_processed = [preprocess_text(text) for text in X_test_text]

    # Feature Extraction - Word Features (TF-IDF)
    print("Creating TF-IDF word features...")
    vectorizer_word = TfidfVectorizer(
        max_features=10000,
        ngram_range=(1, 3),
        stop_words="english",
        sublinear_tf=True,
        min_df=2,
        max_df=0.95,
        use_idf=True,
        norm="l2",
    )

    X_train_word_vec = vectorizer_word.fit_transform(X_train_processed)
    X_test_word_vec = vectorizer_word.transform(X_test_processed)

    # Feature Extraction - Character Level Features (TF-IDF)
    print("Creating TF-IDF character features...")
    vectorizer_char = TfidfVectorizer(
        analyzer="char_wb",
        max_features=10000,
        ngram_range=(3, 4),
        min_df=5,
        max_df=0.95,
        use_idf=True,
        norm="l2",
    )

    X_train_char_vec = vectorizer_char.fit_transform(X_train_processed)
    X_test_char_vec = vectorizer_char.transform(X_test_processed)

    # Compute document-level sentence statistics
    print("Computing document statistics...")
    doc_stats_list = []
    for text in X_train_processed:
        stats = compute_doc_stats(text)
        # Convert dict to ordered list to maintain consistent column order
        stats_array = np.array(
            [[stats["punc_ratio"], stats["capital_ratio"], stats["total_punct"]]]
        )
        doc_stats_list.append(stats_array)

    doc_stats_train = np.vstack(doc_stats_list)

    doc_stats_list_test = []
    for text in X_test_processed:
        stats = compute_doc_stats(text)
        stats_array = np.array(
            [[stats["punc_ratio"], stats["capital_ratio"], stats["total_punct"]]]
        )
        doc_stats_list_test.append(stats_array)

    doc_stats_test = np.vstack(doc_stats_list_test)

    # Combine all features
    print("Combining all features...")
    X_train_combined = np.hstack(
        [X_train_word_vec.toarray(), X_train_char_vec.toarray(), doc_stats_train]
    )
    X_test_combined = np.hstack(
        [X_test_word_vec.toarray(), X_test_char_vec.toarray(), doc_stats_test]
    )

    # Holdout Validation Split
    print("Splitting validation set...")
    X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
        X_train_combined, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
    )

    # Train Model (on training split only)
    print("Training Multinomial Naive Bayes...")
    model = MultinomialNB(alpha=1.0, class_prior=None)
    model.fit(X_tr, y_tr)

    # Validate on HOLDOUT set (model never saw this data)
    print("Calculating Validation Metric...")
    y_pred_prob_val = model.predict_proba(X_val)
    valid_log_loss = log_loss(y_val, y_pred_prob_val)
    print(f"Validation Log Loss: {valid_log_loss:.6f}")

    # Final Training on ALL TRAIN DATA (for submission purposes)
    print("Retraining on full training data...")
    model_final = MultinomialNB(alpha=1.0, class_prior=None)
    model_final.fit(X_train_combined, y_train)

    # Predict on Test Set
    print("Predicting on Test Set...")
    y_test_pred = model_final.predict_proba(X_test_combined)

    # Clip probabilities to avoid log(0) issues during saving (not used for validation)
    y_test_pred_clipped = np.clip(y_test_pred, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)

    # Create Submission - MUST save to submission/submission.csv
    submission = pd.DataFrame(
        {
            "id": ids_test,
            "EAP": y_test_pred_clipped[:, 0],
            "HPL": y_test_pred_clipped[:, 1],
            "MWS": y_test_pred_clipped[:, 2],
        }
    )

    expected_cols = ["id", "EAP", "HPL", "MWS"]
    submission = submission.reindex(columns=expected_cols)

    # Save Submission
    output_path = os.path.join(submission_path, "submission.csv")
    submission.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
    print(f"Submission saved to {output_path}")

    print(f"\nFinal Evaluation Metric (Log Loss on Holdout): {valid_log_loss:.6f}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
